14 October 2026

Added Thinking, an optional dashboard setting. Before acting, the AI double-checks borderline matches and writes down its reasoning. Each case now shows what the AI decided, its reasoning and the original message. Thinking is off by default, and its reasoning is deleted with the original message after 30 days.

Added join protection options. New members can't send links or attachments for a set time after joining: 1 day by default, adjustable from 1 hour to 30 days. They get a DM when it starts and another when it ends. On by default.
Changed the link policy: link protection is now on by default and removes every link except GifBox links. Servers that had already changed these settings keep their choice.
Cases now name only the categories that scored 90% or higher.

Join protection, which is on by default, records only the server, your account ID and when your protection starts and ends. This record is deleted when the protection ends or when you leave the server.
